limitation: Rebuilding the image from this recipe (Dockerfile + build.sh + patches) is NOT expected to reproduce image_id, docker_save_sha256 or definition_kore_sha256: kompile output is not byte-deterministic across runs, and image layers carry timestamps. The recipe documents how the checker was made; it does not let a consumer re-derive it. The consumer must obtain the exact image by its id (distributed out of band as the docker-save tar; it is not in a public registry), check docker_save_sha256 before `docker load` and image_id after, and keep the image outside the bundle (outside_bundle).
